title: cruciata ciliata var. nana
intro: Cruciata ciliata var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Bedstraw, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a sedative, anti-spasmodic, and antiseptic, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Bedstraw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
